permitFee.note: Applying for a seller's permit through the Idaho Business Registration process is free.

penalty.note: 5% of the tax for each month or part of a month the return is late, up to 25%, with a $10 minimum; 0.5% a month on tax filed but unpaid.

unemployment.note: No current official penalty amount for a late wage report was found in the state agency's published sources.

newHire.note: Idaho sets no penalty for late new hire reports; a 2012 bill to add one died.

laborPosters.note: No penalty amount specific to the required workplace notices was found in the state's labor and workers' compensation sources.

workersComp.note: Civil exposure of $2 per employee per day or $25 a day, whichever is greater (Idaho Code 72-319), alongside a misdemeanor.

local.title: City business license
local.description: Some Idaho cities require business licenses; most licensing is industry-specific.

industry.contractor: Idaho Division of Occupational and Professional Licenses (contractor registration)
industry.alcohol: Idaho State Police, Alcohol Beverage Control
industry.childCare: Idaho Department of Health and Welfare (with city/county licensing)
